queries.query: "LLM" OR "large language model" AND ("network configuration" OR "NetOps" OR "network operations") AND (failure OR error OR incorrect OR unsafe OR hallucination)
queries.rationale: Map documented phenomena where LLMs produce incorrect or unsafe NetOps artifacts; establish empirical examples and reported failure modes specific to network configuration tasks.

queries.query: "generate-validate-repair" OR "generate-then-verify" OR "validator-assisted" AND (LLM OR "language model") AND (network OR configuration OR "change plan")
queries.rationale: Locate architectural patterns using a verifier/validator loop for LLM outputs; essential for mitigation strategies in NetOps.

queries.query: "network configuration" AND (verification OR verifier OR "formal verification" OR "reachability" OR "policy compliance") AND (Batfish OR "VeriFlow" OR "NetPlanner" OR "Minesweeper")
queries.rationale: Survey mature deterministic/network verification tools and techniques that can serve as validators or ground-truth for experiments.

queries.query: "LLM" OR "chatbot" OR "agent" AND ("configuration generation" OR "intent-to-configuration" OR "intent-to-policy") AND (evaluation OR accuracy OR robustness)
queries.rationale: Find prior empirical evaluations of LLMs producing network configurations or translating operator intent to configs, to position gaps beyond knowledge tests.

queries.query: "tool-augmented" OR "tool-using" OR "external-tool" AND (LLM OR "language model") AND (execution OR "network CLI" OR "API")
queries.rationale: Identify work on LLMs invoking tools or CLIs for NetOps (or analogous domains) and how tool use changes reliability and safety.

queries.query: "bounded self-correction" OR "iterative repair" OR "autorepair" AND (LLM OR "language model") AND (network OR configuration OR "code repair")
queries.rationale: Search methods that bound or iteratively correct LLM outputs; relevant mitigations for agentic NetOps workflows to reduce unsafe changes.

queries.query: "prompt sensitivity" OR "prompt robustness" AND (LLM OR "large language model") AND (structured output OR JSON OR YAML OR CLI)
queries.rationale: Understand how prompt phrasing and templates affect syntactic and semantic correctness of structured network outputs; informs experimental controls and construct validity.

queries.query: "AIOps" OR "ML for operations" OR "AIOps benchmark" OR "OpsEval" OR "6G-Bench" OR "TSNBench"
queries.rationale: Locate existing AIOps/NetOps benchmarks, their task definitions, metrics, and limitations to evaluate benchmark validity and nearest work.

queries.query: "simulation" OR "emulation" AND (Mininet OR NS-3 OR GNS3) AND (network configuration OR change validation OR experiment)
queries.rationale: Find established simulation/emulation environments for validating config changes and measuring operational impact; crucial for realistic evaluation methods.

queries.query: "human-in-the-loop" OR "operator oversight" AND (LLM OR agent) AND (network OR NetOps)
queries.rationale: Survey human-operator oversight patterns, approval gating, and HCI considerations for safe NetOps agent deployment; informs mitigation and experimental baselines.

queries.query: "agentic AI" OR "autonomous agent" AND (safety OR verification OR "action validation") AND (network OR systems)
queries.rationale: Broaden to agentic AI safety literature on validating actions before execution; adapt mechanisms and failure analyses to NetOps context.

queries.query: "benchmark validity" OR "construct validity" OR "external validity" AND (benchmark OR dataset) AND (AIOps OR NetOps OR "LLM evaluation")
queries.rationale: Search methodological literature on benchmarking validity to guide assessment of existing NetOps/LLM benchmarks and design better evaluative methods.

queries.query: "failure taxonomy" OR "error taxonomy" AND (LLM OR "language model" OR agent) AND (action OR instruction OR configuration)
queries.rationale: Find taxonomies categorizing hallucinations, omission, contradiction, precision mistakes and action-level errors to structure failure analysis.

queries.query: "dataset" OR "corpus" AND (network configuration OR router config OR IOS config OR Juniper) AND (public OR repository)
queries.rationale: Locate public datasets of real or synthetic network configurations and change logs for realistic tasks and external validity assessments.

queries.query: "rollback" OR "change failure" OR "configuration error" AND (network operations OR NetOps OR "change management") AND (metrics OR "failure rate")
queries.rationale: Identify operational metrics and historical studies on change-induced outages and rollbacks to define meaningful success/failure metrics for experiments.

inclusion_criteria: Peer-reviewed conference or journal papers; recent high-quality preprints (arXiv) with verifiable metadata; public datasets and code repositories with provenance; tool/project documentation for verifiers/emulators; position papers and system descriptions describing NetOps deployments or change-management metrics.
Works published or available up to the current date (inclusive) emphasizing 2020–2026 but allowing earlier seminal works.
exclusion_criteria: Non-English sources without reliable translation; vendor marketing collateral or product-only claims lacking technical detail; private/internal reports behind NDAs; blog posts or news without primary technical references (except for operational leads where primary sources are referenced); fabricated or unverifiable citations.
date_rationale: Prioritize literature from 2020–2026 to capture recent LLM/agentic advances and AIOps work, while including earlier seminal network-verification and operations research. Ensure all retrieved sources are verified (title, authors, venue, DOI/arXiv ID) and record retrieval timestamps.
